title: 第25章 突破炼肉境第26章 狂刀三叠浪
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
在狂刀武馆练武，没有硬性要求，想练就练；
不想练，练累了，外面去玩也行，但必须告知弟子，另外学费必须交齐。
赵寒为了不特立独行，引人注目，拿起了一把木刀，在角落开始“磕磕绊绊”的练狂刀九式。
等晨练结束，不少人散去，三五成群的外出吃早饭。
赵寒也跟着走了出去，在武馆附近的一家面摊上，点了一碗价值五文钱的臊子面，大口吃了起来。
周围也有不少人吃饭。
“听说了吗，毒蛇帮毒龙堂一名叫王豹的头目被手下帮众杀了，这会毒蛇帮正广发通缉令呢。”
“据说是个炼皮武者干的，只要提供确切消息，就悬赏五两银子呢。”
“如果能杀了这凶手，还能得到二十两银子的悬赏。”
赵寒一听，吃面的速度缓了下来，竖起耳朵仔细听。
“就这，才这么点钱谁特么去卖命啊。”
“毕竟也就一个小头目，毒蛇帮不可能大动干戈，可能这钱都是毒龙堂出的。”
赵寒默默吃着面，心道：
“我马上可就是炼肉境了，这点钱通缉一名炼肉境，真是做白日梦啊。”
吃过了面，赵寒从附近的摊位买了个斗笠戴在头上。
随后朝着附近的张贴栏走去。
张贴栏，便是花钱给黑水县县衙，得以张贴各种信息。
如通缉令、招工启事、寻人启事等等。
来到张贴栏，已经围满了人，正对着张贴栏指指点点。
赵寒虽然相貌平平无奇，可身高还是有的，足足一米七八，在这个世界算是高个了。

哪怕站在人群外面，也能看到张贴栏上的信息。
“就这灵魂画手，能抓到人就有诡了。”
当看到悬赏画像，赵寒好悬没笑出声。
哪怕是现代稍微学过画画的，都不可能把人像画成这样。
只见张贴栏的通缉令上，画着一个奇丑无比，神色扭曲的人，看起来就像是肾透支一样。
无论如何，凭借这副画像也不可能牵扯到自己。
怪不得之前吃面时，没人在意自己，原来是我原貌太平平无奇了，远不如这通缉画像上的容易辨认。
“这丑八怪长的真丑，一看就是个江洋大盗。”
“人家只是毒蛇帮的帮众而已，哪来的江洋大盗啊，不过确实挺丑的。”
“这么丑的人还是很容易找到的，走吧，我们到处去瞧瞧，说不定就发现了。”
人群中熙熙攘攘，赵寒却已经摘下斗笠走远了。
光明正大的走在街上，回头率为零，无人在意。
平平无奇的脸，看过一次就忘记的那种。
一路安全走入一条武馆附近的巷子。
来到有些废弃脏乱的无人之处，赵寒深吸一口气，随即开始练拳。
五分钟过后，熟练度已达到990点。
“再休息一会，继续加练。”
赵寒看了看四周，发现一个废弃宅院，围墙还挺高，双眼一亮。
往后退了几步，然后快速箭步上前，一个跳跃起身抓起废弃墙壁就翻了进去。
双眼扫视，这废弃宅子规模还不小，看样子之前是大户人家的大院。

可惜年久失修，或是遭遇了什么变故，彻底废弃，地面杂草都长满了。
content_en:
There are no hard requirements for practicing martial arts in the Crazy Blade Martial Arts Hall, you can practice whenever you want;
If you don’t want to practice or are tired of practicing, you can go outside to play, but you must inform the disciples, and the tuition must be paid in full.
In order not to stand out and attract attention, Zhao Han picked up a wooden knife and started to practice the nine styles of Crazy Sword in the corner.
After the morning exercise ended, many people dispersed and went out to have breakfast in small groups.
Zhao Han also walked out, ordered a bowl of saucy noodles worth five cents at a noodle stall near the martial arts school, and ate it.
There are also many people eating around.
"Have you heard that the leader of the Poisonous Dragon Hall of the Poisonous Snake Gang named Wang Bao was killed by his subordinates? Now the Poisonous Snake Gang is issuing a wanted order."
"It is said that a skin refining warrior did it. As long as you provide accurate information, there is a reward of five taels of silver."
"If you can kill this murderer, you can get a reward of twenty taels of silver."
When Zhao Han heard this, he slowed down his eating speed and listened carefully.
"That's it. Who the hell is going to work for such a small amount of money?"
"After all, it's just a small leader. It's impossible for the Poisonous Snake Gang to start a big war. Maybe all the money came from Poisonous Dragon Hall."
Zhao Han ate the noodles silently and thought to himself:
"I will be in the meat-refining realm soon. With this little money to arrest someone in the meat-refining realm, it's really a daydream."
After eating the noodles, Zhao Han bought a bamboo hat from a nearby stall and put it on his head.
Then he walked towards the nearby poster board.
The poster board means paying money to the Heishui County government office to post various information.
Such as wanted notices, job recruitment notices, missing person notices, etc.
When we came to the posting board, we were already surrounded by people, pointing at the posting board.
Although Zhao Han has an ordinary appearance, he is still tall, at 1.78 meters, which is considered tall in this world.
Even if you stand outside the crowd, you can still see the information on the bulletin board.
"Just like this soul painter, if he can catch people, he is very cunning."
When he saw the reward portrait, Zhao Han managed not to laugh out loud.
Even modern people who have learned a little bit about painting would not be able to draw portraits like this.
On the wanted poster on the poster board, there was a picture of an extremely ugly man with a distorted expression, who looked like he had a kidney overdraft.
In any case, it is impossible to implicate himself with this portrait.
No wonder no one paid attention to me when I was eating noodles before. It turns out that my original appearance was too ordinary and not as easy to identify as the one in this wanted portrait.
"This ugly guy is really ugly. He looks like a gangster at first glance."
"I'm just a member of the Viper Gang. How can I be a gangster? But he's really ugly."
"It's easy to find such an ugly person. Let's go and look around. Maybe we'll find it."
The crowd was bustling with people, but Zhao Han had already taken off his bamboo hat and walked away.
Walking on the street openly, no one turns around, no one cares.
An ordinary face, the kind that you see once and then forget.
We walked safely into an alley near a martial arts school.
Arriving at a deserted, dirty and uninhabited place, Zhao Han took a deep breath and immediately began to practice boxing.
After five minutes, the proficiency level reached 990 points.
"Take another rest and continue training."
Zhao Han looked around and found an abandoned house with quite high walls, and his eyes lit up.
He took a few steps back, then quickly stepped forward, jumped up, grabbed the abandoned wall, and climbed in.
Scanning his eyes, he found that the abandoned house was quite large. It looked like it had been the compound of a wealthy family before.
It's a pity that it fell into disrepair or suffered some accident and was completely abandoned, and the ground was overgrown with weeds.
